# World Models & Generative Simulation

<!-- generated from data/world-models.yaml; do not edit by hand -->

Two overlapping lines: (1) generative world models that predict future observations conditioned on actions,
used as simulators and data engines; (2) world-action models that use prediction as a training signal for planners.
Evaluation: [DrivingGen](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.01528) and others in [Benchmarks](benchmarks.md).

**37 entries**, newest first within each section. Add papers by editing `data/world-models.yaml` (see [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
